comments.body: Orion requests a pro-rata refund for the rest of the current term. The two SEV-1 outages in August breached the 99.9% SLA in our MSA, and Section 7.3 gives us a refund right within 60 days of the 15 August renewal.
Thanks Dana. Per our refund policy, annual subscriptions can only be refunded within 30 days of the renewal date, so I'm afraid we can't offer a refund. We can look into service credits for August.
That is not what our contract says. Please escalate this to someone who has read our MSA.

Sam quoted the 2023 refund policy (30 days). The current policy is POL-007 v2 and Orion's MSA has clause 7.3. Escalated to Tomás Herrera (RevOps) for the decision. Do not promise anything until RevOps approves.
